summary: Proposes experimental extensions to TCP so it can use fast, long-delay network paths efficiently, where the original header limits made it hard to keep the pipe full. It is an Experimental document that asked for discussion, and it was replaced by RFC 1323.

eli5.summary: A long, fat water pipe only works well if you keep pouring in lots of water at once. This fixes a rule that limited how much could be poured.

questions: how can tcp work better on high speed paths
what tcp extensions did rfc 1185 propose
